merge_note: Fragment only. Merge the hooks.Stop entry into an existing Claude Code settings hooks list and keep every existing Stop hook entry already present. Mount it beside the UserPromptSubmit fragment: the answer is linked to the prompt that hook captured. Needs canon 0.4.0 or later; canon 0.3.0 rejects --capture. An answer is stored only when this Stop input carries the prompt id and last_assistant_message, which the tests supply synthetically.
